veranderings.voor: die temperatuur hoër en die dae
veranderings.na: die temperatuur hoër, en die dae
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb (temperatuur is / dae is).
Afrikaans normally uses the expletive 'daar' with an indefinite subject like 'reën' in this clause.

veranderings.na: val daar reën deur die jaar
veranderings.rede: The indefinite subject 'reën' after the verb reads more naturally with 'daar'.
